import { MongoClient, Binary, Decimal128, Long, MaxKey, MinKey, ObjectId, Timestamp, UUID } from "mongodb";

const client = new MongoClient(process.env.MONGODB_URI ?? "mongodb://localhost:27017");

const filter = {
  id: new ObjectId("65f1c0de9a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b"),
  at: new Date("2024-03-01T10:20:30.123Z"),
  long: Long.fromString("9007199254740993"),
  decimal: Decimal128.fromString("0.10"),
  int: 42,
  double: 2.5,
  big: 3000000000,
  regex: /^ma/i,
  uuid: new UUID("3b241101-e2bb-4255-8caf-4136c566a962"),
  binary: new Binary(Buffer.from("AQID", "base64"), 0x00),
  timestamp: new Timestamp({ t: 1700000000, i: 1 }),
  min: new MinKey(),
  max: new MaxKey(),
  none: null,
  yes: true,
  nan: NaN,
  list: [1, "a"],
  empty: {}
};
const sort = { at: -1 };

try {
  const cursor = client.db("shop").collection("orders").find(filter, { sort });
  for await (const doc of cursor) {
    console.log(doc);
  }
} finally {
  await client.close();
}
